program_name: Cryptomus Affiliate Program (publisher) and Referral Program (customer)
legal_entity: Not disclosed — the affiliate page, the Terms of Use (17 Aug 2026) and the AML policy name only 'Cryptomus'.
application_conditions: Affiliate types listed: Merchants, Influencers, Media, Anyone; 'We are open to partnering with anyone who has more than 5,000 subscribers'; applicants are moderated ('We carefully review the content and activity of each potential partner'). Customer referral programme available to any account via a referral code in account settings.
paid_action: Referred users' fees: 30% of the payment (gateway) commission paid by the referral; trading: 40% of the fees paid by direct referrals and 5% of second-level referrals' fees. Nothing is stated for card issuance or card top-up fees.
validation_conditions: Not stated on the pages read.

commission.model_note: Revenue share on referred users' fees: 30% of payment commissions; 40% (level 1) / 5% (level 2) of trade fees. The FAQ adds that after USD 5,000 of total turnover the rate can be 'up to 25% for the next 30 days' and then decreases every 30 days according to a 'personal plan' (customer referral programme). The 25%-of-card-top-up-fee rate described by a directory (dailytrust) does not appear on any official page read.

payout.holdbacks_note: Special bonuses negotiated individually with a manager; commission plan 'depends on the type of project'.

rules_note: No affiliate-specific terms linked (footer links to the general Terms of Use). Fee-share model on payment and trading fees — no card-related commission published. Nobody contacted, no application made. The card itself is blocked (no dedicated fee schedule, operator/issuer undisclosed) — see data/candidates.json.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated. Terms of Use: Cryptomus 'does not serve U.S. citizens or residents'.

evidence.title: Affiliate program — Cryptomus
evidence.excerpt: 'Receive 30% of the payment commission paid by your referral'; 'Earn 40% of the fees paid by your direct referrals and 5% of the fees paid by second-level referrals'; 'Partner payments for referrals arrive daily'; open to 'anyone who has more than 5,000 subscribers'; partners moderated; types Merchants, Influencers, Media, Anyone. No legal entity, no cookie window, no card commission.

evidence.title: How to take part in the partner program? (Cryptomus FAQ)
evidence.excerpt: Referral code in account settings; 30% of each referral's payment fees; after USD 5,000 total turnover 'up to 25% for the next 30 days', then the rate drops every 30 days per the personal plan; plan depends on project type (contact a personal manager).

evidence.title: Terms of Use — Cryptomus (last updated 17 Aug 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Platform 'governed and maintained by Cryptomus'; governing law 'of the country where the Company is registered' (not named); 'Cryptomus does not serve U.S. citizens or residents'; virtual cards 'issued by the Platform', allowed only after KYC/AML (§9.7).

notes: Recorded while the Cryptomus Card candidate was blocked (research run 2026-11-18). Useful only if the card is later documented; the programme's published commissions concern payment-gateway and trading fees, not cards.
